columns.name: ProviderNumber
columns.description: An integer hospital provider identifier, with values ranging from 10001 to 20018. It functions as a code rather than a measured quantity.

columns.name: HospitalName
columns.description: The name of the hospital associated with the record. The profile shows 46 distinct names and no missing values.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: The hospital’s street address. The values are text addresses, with 46 distinct entries.

columns.name: City
columns.description: The city where the hospital is located. The profile shows 39 distinct city names.

columns.name: State
columns.description: A two-letter state abbreviation identifying the hospital’s state. The observed values are AK, AL, and OH.

columns.name: ZipCode
columns.description: The hospital’s ZIP code, stored as an integer and ranging from 35007 to 99559. It is a geographic code, not a quantity.

columns.name: CountyName
columns.description: The name of the county where the hospital is located. The profile shows 34 distinct county names.

columns.name: PhoneNumber
columns.description: The hospital’s telephone number, stored as an integer. The values have the scale of 10-digit phone numbers and should be interpreted as contact identifiers, not quantities.

columns.name: HospitalType
columns.description: A category describing the hospital type; the observed values are “acute care hospitals” and “acute care hospitals c.” The profile does not clarify the meaning of the “c.” suffix.

columns.name: HospitalOwner
columns.description: The hospital’s ownership category, with values distinguishing government, proprietary, and voluntary non-profit ownership types. The eight observed values include specific government levels and non-profit subcategories.

columns.name: EmergencyService
columns.description: Indicates whether the hospital offers emergency service, encoded as “yes” or “no.”

columns.name: Condition
columns.description: The condition or care area associated with the reported measure, such as heart attack, heart failure, pneumonia, or surgical infection prevention. Six condition categories are present.

columns.name: MeasureCode
columns.description: A code identifying a hospital quality measure, with values such as “ami-1” and “hf-2.” MeasureName contains descriptive measure text, though the profiles do not show a one-to-one mapping between the two columns.

columns.name: MeasureName
columns.description: A text description of the hospital care or treatment measure, such as whether heart attack patients were given aspirin at arrival. The descriptions correspond to measures identified by MeasureCode, but the profile does not establish a one-to-one mapping.

columns.name: Score
columns.description: A reported measure score, represented as text with percentage values such as “100%” and “97%.” The special value “empty” indicates an empty score entry; the profile does not specify why it occurs.

columns.name: Sample
columns.description: The number of patients in the sample for a measure, represented as text with values such as “0 patients” and “4 patients.” The special value “empty” indicates an empty sample entry; the profile does not specify why it occurs.

columns.name: Stateavg
columns.description: A code-like value combining a state abbreviation and a measure code, such as “al_ami-1.” It appears to identify a state-and-measure grouping, but the profile does not show an accompanying state-average value or define the encoding further.
